build_diffusion_compressor: build a compressor with DiffusionMixin to quantize Stable Diffusion or FLUX models
calibrate_diffusion_model: run calibration on a diffusion pipeline using text prompts and denoising steps
save_quantized_diffusion: save a quantized diffusion pipeline with all components to an output directory
configure_diffusion_parameters: configure guidance scale, inference steps, and generator seed for diffusion quantization
wrap_block_forward: wrap a diffusion model block forward function to handle positional arguments as kwargs
